reviewer: Separate read-only peer verification process. No owner identity, human acceptance, trust credential, or closure authority is claimed.

reviewMethod.typedInputs: For every operation case pair, compare its recorded currentTypedInputSlots byte-structure to the live capability ownerDefinition.typedInputSlots, and verify the positive and negative GWT text carries those exact typed slots.
reviewMethod.outputs: Compare currentSuccessOutputs byte-structure to live ownerDefinition.successOutputs and verify the positive then clause includes exact output shape and owner semanticOutcomeContract result.
reviewMethod.operation: Compare operation name to live capability.operation and verify the exact capability.operation appears in the positive invocation.
reviewMethod.negativeBoundary: Compare non-success outputs, error values, authority list, and unsupported cases to live source; verify all are represented in the negative clause.
reviewMethod.integration: Verify current parent requirement references, original audit source reference, postimage acceptance case IDs/indexes and actual serialized YAML cases.
